in_sanskrit.name: क्रांति
in_sanskrit.long_meaning: A sudden, violent, or revolutionary change or action; a revolutionary act or movement.

in_hindi.name: क्रांति
in_hindi.long_meaning: क्रिया (action, process) + क्रांति (motion) = शुद्ध क्रिया (pure action, revolution)

in_tamil.name: க்ராண்டி
in_tamil.long_meaning: மொழிகள் (waves) + க்ராண்டி (movement) = மொழிகள் அன்பில் அகிலம் (waves of revolution)

in_telugu.name: క్రాంతి
in_telugu.long_meaning: పోయేదు (movement) + క్రాంతి (forceful) = పోయేదుపై చేయిపోయేదు (movement with force)

in_marathi.name: Kranti
in_marathi.long_meaning: Kranti हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। Kranti is a Sanskrit term that means revolution or change. It is derived from the root verb 'krant' which means to move or to change. In Hindu mythology, Kranti is associated with the god Vishnu, who is known as the preserver and the bringer of change. The name is also used for individuals who are agents of change and revolution.
